name: Free the Hollows

angles.text: As an island elf, you know Shadowgale Forest has long been feared as haunted, its spirits bound to ancient ruins.
As a priest, you see the wind hollows as sorrowful spirits trapped by tragedy. Destroying them is seen as mercy, releasing souls bound in anguish.
As a druid, you know the unquiet spirits in Shadowgale Forest disturb the wilderness and call for balance and release.

faq.answer: Wind hollows are sorrowful, ghost-like spirits haunting old elven ruins in northeastern Shadowgale Forest. Bound by an ancient tragedy, they sing mournfully through the trees at night.
The spirits are believed to remain bound by a terrible catastrophe and trapped in sorrow. Destroying them is seen as an act of mercy that releases their lingering forms from the ruins.
faq.q: Why do the wind hollows need to be freed?

faq.answer: The spirits gather among ancient ruins in the northeastern woods of Shadowgale Forest, an island woodland inhabited by elves.
The wind hollows sing a sorrowful melody unlike any ordinary tune. Their song is thought to come from their tragic end and their endless confinement among the island’s ruins.
faq.q: What is the strange singing heard in the woods?

faq.answer: An island observer who pities the trapped spirits asks you to free them, mindful that local elves fear the haunted woods.
faq.q: Who asks you to free the hollows?

faq.answer: The exact details are lost to time, but locals know a terrible event took place at the northeastern ruins and bound the spirits there in endless sorrow.
faq.q: What happened at the ruins to create the hollows?

sections.body: Elves across the island have long feared Shadowgale Forest as a haunted grove. In its northeastern woods, old stone ruins lie beneath the overgrowth. Ghost-like wind hollows drift there without rest, but they show no malice. Their sorrow points to a disaster that befell the ruins ages ago.
sections.title: Hauntings of Shadowgale

sections.body: On quiet nights, travelers near the ruins hear strange singing on the breeze. No mortal song sounds like it, and its deep melancholy unsettles those who hear it. Compassionate travelers believe the shades suffer in their endless lament. They seek the wind hollows to break their spectral bonds and grant them peace.
sections.title: The Mournful Song

summary: In Shadowgale Forest, the wind hollows’ sorrowful song carries through ancient ruins. An old tragedy binds these ghost-like spirits, and travelers seek to give them peace.
attribution: In-game quest text: Free the Hollows
